properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored CryptoJS RC4/RC4Drop implementation shipped inside the client bundle (all 5 sites are the library's own class definitions and helper registration in crypto-js.js:5322-5412). No application call site found — the app (FakeHashcat.js) reaches the library only for MD5, HmacMD5, HmacSHA1 and hex encoding. RC4 ships in the bundle whether or not it is called; it is broken (keystream biases) independently of quantum computing. Changeable here by dropping RC4 from the vendored build.
